annotation.authors_or_issuer: Senado Federal do Brasil – Comissão de Juristas responsável por subsidiar elaboração de substitutivo sobre inteligência artificial (CJSUBIA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Lists public hearings of the Brazilian jurists' commission drafting the AI bill substitute, April–June 2022.
International seminar on 9–10 June 2022 with experts from the EU, US, Africa and Latin America.
Panels cover civil liability regimes, bias and discrimination, transparency and explainability, and human review.
Panels also cover regulatory oversight bodies, sandboxes, impact assessments and ethical codes.
Sectoral panels address public security, industry and child protection.
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Senate web page listing public hearings and international seminar panels of the Commission of Jurists (CJSUBIA) tasked with informing the AI bill substitute in 2022. It lists invited speakers and topics such as civil liability, bias, transparency, oversight bodies and sandboxes. It contains no robotics-specific content.
annotation.title_en: Public Hearings of the CJSUBIA (Commission of Jurists on Artificial Intelligence)
